description: A 100mm x 60mm x 5mm aluminum rectangular plate.
A 100mm x 60mm x 20mm aluminum block with four 5mm through-holes, one at each corner, 10mm from each edge.
An L-shaped steel bracket. Both legs are 50mm long, 30mm wide, and 4mm thick. Each leg has two 6mm clearance holes spaced 30mm apart along its length.
A 50mm cube with a 3mm chamfer on every edge.
A two-step block. The base is 80mm x 50mm x 10mm. A second 50mm x 30mm x 12mm step sits centered on top of the base.
A 60mm x 30mm x 4mm steel bracket with a 20mm-long, 5mm-wide rectangular slot centered along its length, plus a 6mm hole 8mm from each short edge.
A 60mm-diameter, 6mm-thick circular flange with six M5 clearance holes evenly spaced on a 45mm bolt circle.
A 20-tooth involute spur gear with module 2.0, 10mm thickness, and an 8mm bore.
A V-belt pulley with 60mm outer diameter, 20mm bore, and 15mm width. Include a 4mm-deep V-groove with 40 degree included angle around the outer rim.
A 20mm diameter, 100mm long round shaft with a 5mm wide, 3mm deep keyway machined into the side, running 30mm long starting 10mm from one end.
A bearing housing for a 22mm OD, 8mm wide bearing. Outer housing diameter 35mm, length 12mm, with a 2mm retaining lip on one end.
An M8x1.25 threaded rod, 60mm long, with a 1mm chamfer on each end.
An M10 hex head bolt, 40mm long with 1.5mm thread pitch and 17mm width across flats.

A 12mm thick eccentric cam with a 40mm base circle. The cam profile rises smoothly to a 10mm peak over 180 degrees and falls back over the next 180 degrees. Includes a 10mm bore at its rotational center, offset 8mm from the geometric center of the profile.
An ergonomic handle, 120mm long. The cross-section is elliptical, tapering from 25mm x 20mm at the base to 18mm x 14mm at the tip.

A water bottle grip section, 100mm tall. The cross-section is a smooth three-lobed profile with a 30mm circumscribed diameter at the bottom, narrowing to 26mm at mid-height (50mm) and back out to 30mm at the top.
A teardrop-shaped pendant, 30mm wide at its rounded base, 50mm tall to the pointed tip, and 10mm thick. Smooth side surfaces.

An organic drawer pull. The body is 90mm long. The cross-section is an elongated ellipse: 30mm x 12mm at each end, smoothly bulging to 36mm x 18mm in the middle. Two 4mm mounting bosses on the back, 60mm apart.
A perfume bottle body, 80mm tall, lofted between three circular cross-sections: 40mm diameter at the base, 50mm diameter at 30mm height, and 22mm diameter at the top.

A table lamp base, 100mm tall, formed by revolving a smooth profile that goes from 80mm diameter at the floor, narrows to 35mm diameter at 70mm height, and flares back out to 50mm diameter at the top.
A water-droplet pendant lofted from a 20mm diameter circle at the base to a 2mm rounded tip 35mm above. 10mm thick across its widest point.
A duct transition piece, 60mm tall, lofted between a 50mm diameter circle at the bottom and a 40mm x 40mm square at the top. Wall thickness 2mm.

An ergonomic grip 110mm long. The cross-section is an oval that varies along the length: 28mm x 22mm at one end, narrowing to 24mm x 18mm at the midpoint (55mm), and back out to 30mm x 24mm at the opposite end.

A decorative doorknob lofted along a 60mm axis. The profile is a rounded three-lobed flower shape with a 35mm circumscribed diameter at both ends, swelling to a 45mm circumscribed diameter at the middle. Single solid (no internal cavity).
A chair leg 420mm long, lofted between three sections: a 50mm x 50mm rounded square at the floor, a 35mm circle at the midpoint, and a 60mm x 40mm rounded rectangle at the seat-attachment top.

A swan-neck faucet body. Sweeping curve in the XZ plane, 200mm tall. Circular cross-section that tapers from 28mm diameter at the base to 18mm diameter at the spout outlet. The path arcs forward 90mm along X over the height.
A NACA 0012 airfoil segment with 100mm chord and 200mm span, generated as a single solid (no internal structure).
A NACA 2412 wing segment, 150mm chord, 300mm span, with 3 internal ribs evenly spaced along the span and a single forward spar at 25 percent chord. Skin thickness 1.5mm.
A tapered vertical fin with 80mm root chord, 40mm tip chord, 100mm span, NACA 0006 cross-section. No internal structure.
A NACA 4412 cambered airfoil segment, 120mm chord, 250mm span, generated as a single solid (no internal structure).
A swept winglet. NACA 0008 cross-section, 60mm root chord, 30mm tip chord, 80mm span. Sweep the leading edge back 25 degrees over the span. Single solid skin, no ribs.
A NACA 2412 wing panel, 140mm chord, 320mm span, with 5 degrees of dihedral applied along the span. Two evenly spaced internal ribs. Skin thickness 1.2mm.
A horizontal stabilizer using a NACA 0010 symmetric airfoil. 90mm root chord, 60mm tip chord, 200mm span, no twist. Two internal ribs at 1/3 and 2/3 span. Skin thickness 1.0mm.
A 1.5mm thick steel L-bracket. The base is 50mm x 30mm; the vertical flange is 40mm x 30mm. 3mm bend radius. Two 5mm mounting holes in the base, 30mm apart.
A 2mm thick aluminum enclosure panel, 100mm x 80mm, with 10mm tall flanges on all four edges bent 90 degrees toward the same side. 2mm bend radius.
A 1.2mm thick steel PCB tray, 120mm x 80mm, with 12mm flanges on the two long edges only. Four 3mm mounting holes, one at each corner of the flat base, 8mm from each edge.
